$comment: Shimla Rising ki kahani aur missions. Objective types jo engine samajhta hai: goto, drive_to, collect, evade, survive, race. Sab 'poi' fields data/pois.json ke id hain.

acts.title: Pahad ka Beta
acts.blurb: Sanjauli ki dhalan pe ek garage, ek maa, aur ek ladka jo abhi tak seedha hai.

acts.title: Mall Road ke Malik
acts.blurb: Devinder Sahab ke darbar mein jagah mil gayi. Keemat baad mein pata chalegi.

acts.title: Barfeela Toofan
acts.blurb: Barf gir rahi hai, saboot pighal raha hai, aur Jakhoo pe ek aakhri raat baaki hai.

missions.title: Garage ki Subah
missions.brief: Amma: 'Uth ja Vicky. Neeche shutter khol, aur Sharma ji ki gaadi aaj hi deni hai. Aur haan - Cart Road se jaana, Mall se nahi.'

objectives.text: Taxi lo aur Sanjauli Chowk pahuncho

missions.title: Lakkar Bazaar ki Reporter
missions.brief: Nafisa: 'Tu ka ladka hai na? Tere baap ne mujhe ek list di thi. Ab wo nahi hai, aur list adhoori hai. Mujhe Dhalli ke depot ki tasveer chahiye.'

missions.title: Cart Road Sprint
missions.brief: Guru: 'Bali ke ladke tere peeche hain. Bhaag mat - chala. Cart Road pe jo pehle pahunchega, wahi jeeta.'

missions.title: Toy Train ka Maal
missions.brief: Chhotu: 'Bhaiya, 4:10 wali chhoti gaadi mein ek dabba aisa hai jo passenger ke liye nahi hai. Goods shed ke peeche.'

missions.title: Chhotu ki Nazar
missions.brief: Chhotu: 'Jakhoo se poora Mall dikhta hai. Aur raat ko jo truck catchment se nikalta hai, wo bhi.'

objectives.text: Catchment gate pe truck ka intezaar karo
Chhupe raho jab tak truck nikal na jaye

missions.title: Garage Jal Gayi
missions.brief: Raat ke do baje Sanjauli mein aag ki roshni. Amma khadi hai, chappal bhi nahi pehni. 'Vicky... neeche mat jaa.' Vicky neeche jaata hai.

objectives.text: Aag se baap ke kaagaz nikalo
Bali ke aadmiyon se bach ke nikal jao
Ghar wapas jao. Amma intezaar kar rahi hai.

missions.title: Devinder Sahab ka Bulawa
missions.brief: Devinder Sahab: 'Beta, teri garage ka bahut dukh hua. Aisa karte hain - tu mere liye kaam kar. Nuksan bhi bhar dunga, aur Shimla bhi dikha dunga.'

objectives.text: Hotel Deodar Palace jao (paidal - Mall pe gaadi ban hai)
Bali ke yard se ek 'parcel' utha lao

missions.title: Tender Fix
missions.brief: Bali: 'Secretariat mein ek file hai. Kal subah tak wo file uss almari mein nahi honi chahiye. Samjha?'

objectives.text: Tender file ke teen hisse uthao
Chaura Maidan ki police se bacho

missions.title: Mall Road Mein Gaadi
missions.brief: Devinder: 'Aaj Mall band hai, sirf VIP ke liye. Meri gaadi Scandal Point pe khadi hai. Le aa. Aur haan - dhyaan se, wahan gaadi le jaana jurm hai.'

objectives.text: Gaadi lekar Scandal Point pahuncho (2-star wanted milega)
Mall Road paar karke Christ Church tak
Police ko chhod ke nikal jao

missions.title: Annandale ka Helipad
missions.brief: Nafisa: 'Kal subah Annandale pe ek helicopter utrega. Usme koi minister nahi aa raha. Mujhe bas ye jaanna hai ki kya utar raha hai.'

missions.title: Viceregal Lodge
missions.brief: Nafisa: '1888 ki building mein 2026 ka ghotala. Devinder ne apna asli register wahin rakha hai - kyunki wahan koi shak nahi karta.'

objectives.text: Guru ke dhabe pe chhup jao

missions.title: Bali ka Yard
missions.brief: Guru: 'Register mein tere baap ka naam bhi hai, Vicky. Galat taraf. Ab tu decide kar - kaagaz jala dega, ya Bali se poochhega.'

objectives.text: Bali ke aadmiyon ko rok ke rakho

missions.title: Catchment ke Andar
missions.brief: Chhotu: 'Bhaiya, barf shuru ho gayi. Jo latthe abhi nahi nikle, wo poore season andar rahenge. Aaj raat aakhri truck hai.'

objectives.text: Catchment gate pahuncho (barf gir rahi hai - grip kam hai)
Kate hue deodar ke stump mark karo
Truck convoy ke guzarne tak ruko

missions.title: Jakhoo par Aakhri Raat
missions.brief: Nafisa: 'Sab kuch ek jagah pahunchana hai, aur ek hi raat hai. Jakhoo. Sabse uncha point - wahan se signal jaayega, aur wahan se sab dikhega.'

objectives.text: Jakhoo ki chadhai chadho - barfeele toofan mein
Saboot bhejte waqt Devinder ke aadmiyon ko rok ke rakho
Pahad utar jao. Kahani ab tumhare bina bhi chalegi.

missions.title: Taxi Rani
missions.brief: ISBT pe sawari khadi hai. Meter chalao aur pahuncha do - jitni tez, utna zyada.

missions.title: Guru ki Bus
missions.brief: Guru: 'Meri kamar gayi hai. Aaj ka Dhalli route tu chala. Bus hai - dheere, par rukegi nahi.'

missions.title: New Shimla Loop
missions.brief: Shimla ki sabse chaudi sadkein. Raat ko yahan sirf ek hi cheez hoti hai.

missions.title: Cart Road Time Trial
missions.brief: ISBT se Sanjauli tak, Cart Road ke har mod se hokar. Ghadi chal rahi hai.

missions.title: Jakhoo ke Bandar
missions.brief: Chhotu: 'Bandaron ne phir se chashme utha liye. Tourist ro rahe hain. Wapas le aao, warna mandir wale mujhe daantenge.'

missions.title: Sanjauli Courier
missions.brief: Amma: 'Ye teen packet gali mein baant de. Scooter le jaana - bus wahan ghusti nahi.'

missions.title: Nafisa ke Photo
missions.brief: Nafisa: 'Har wo building jo dhalan pe khadi hai aur khadi nahi honi chahiye. Tasveer chahiye, bahaana nahi.'

objectives.text: Sanjauli ki avaidh building shoot karo

missions.title: Barf Mein Phasi Gaadi
missions.brief: Guru: 'Tunnel ke aage do gaadiyan phas gayi hain. Barf mein grip nahi milti - dheere chalana.'

missions.title: Apple Lorry
missions.brief: Dhalli mandi se peti ISBT tak. Seb hain - kaagaz bhi poore hain. Is baar sach mein.

missions.title: Chhoti Gaadi ka Peecha
missions.brief: Chhotu: 'Toy train Summer Hill se aa rahi hai. Uske saath-saath chalo - dekho kaunse tunnel pe kaun chadhta hai.'
